title: SMAITE_XD PACK
description: A clean and stylish PvP resource pack made for Minecraft. Includes custom textures and a unique Totem design to improve your PvP experience. Lightweight, smooth, and easy to use for survival or PvP gameplay.
body:
Smaite_XD PVP Pack is a simple and clean 16x Minecraft PvP resource pack made to improve your gameplay experience. This pack features custom textures, a custom Totem design, and a smooth lightweight style that works great for PvP and survival.
✨ Features:
Clean PvP textures
Custom Totem
Lightweight and smooth
16x Resolution
Easy to use
Made by SMITE2969 for Minecraft players who enjoy smooth and stylish gameplay. credit👉[https://youtube.com/@theariyan_gamer45]
